description.zh:
集群编号。
> 您可通过调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口查询该值。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the IDs of clusters.

description.zh:
镜像名称。
> 您可通过调用[GetOpaClusterImageList](~~GetOpaClusterImageList~~)接口查询该值。
description.en:
The name of the image.

>  You can call the [GetOpaClusterImageList](~~GetOpaClusterImageList~~) operation to query the names of images.

description.zh:
容器标签。
> 您可通过调用[GetOpaClusterLabelList](~~GetOpaClusterLabelList~~)接口查询该值。
description.en:
The tag that is added to the container.

>  You can call the [GetOpaClusterLabelList](~~GetOpaClusterLabelList~~) operation to query the tags that are added to containers.

description.zh:
集群命名空间。
> 您可通过调用[GetOpaClusterNamespaceList](~~GetOpaClusterNamespaceList~~)接口查询该值。
description.en:
The namespace of the cluster.

>  You can call the [GetOpaClusterNamespaceList](~~GetOpaClusterNamespaceList~~) operation to query the namespaces of clusters.
